brief.objective: Keep the ModelSpend backlog truthful and dependency-correct while the event-driven Build Manager is proven in supervised shadow mode.
brief.outcome: ModelSpend can participate in the same durable programme, execution and assurance reconciliation graph as Agent Runner without a project-specific scheduler.
constraints: Dell is the sole scheduler and controller
One global implementation slot is shared across registered projects
Subscription quota headroom is the only provider admission signal
nonGoals: Autonomous merge, deployment, issue closure or source activation
Any ModelSpend-specific management timer or separately metered paid fallback
brief.architectureSummary: ModelSpend is managed through the shared Agent Runner project registry, manager profile, durable management event ledger and bounded queue, authority and settlement transitions.
risks: The live backlog may contain historical labels or dependencies that shadow reconciliation must surface before active mutation
A collector outage or ambiguous quota state must fail closed rather than infer readiness
assumptions: The ModelSpend checkout and GitHub repository identity match the registered project configuration
The registered ModelSpend manager profile remains current
escalationQuestions: Which backlog changes would materially alter the ModelSpend product boundary rather than merely reconcile engineering state?
definitionOfDone: Shadow reconciliation produces bounded deterministic status for ModelSpend
No ModelSpend mutation occurs while the management control plane is in shadow mode
Repository validation and exact-head checks are green before any later active cutover

milestones.title: ModelSpend management shadow acceptance
milestones.description: Prove the shared event-driven management graph against live bounded ModelSpend evidence without competing mutation authority.

proposedIssues.title: Record bounded ModelSpend shadow equivalence evidence
proposedIssues.scope: Collect and record bounded comparison evidence showing how the event-driven management graph classifies the current ModelSpend queue while the existing external management tasks remain authoritative.
acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic ModelSpend status projection is recorded from live bounded evidence
Shadow decisions perform no queue mutation or worker-authority publication
Repeated unchanged evidence is durably deduplicated

scope: Implement only the selected bounded ModelSpend issue on the authorised branch and existing pull-request lineage.
stopConditions: Stop and report if the accepted base commit changes.
Stop and report if required validation fails or authoritative evidence is ambiguous.
